observations: Torah #100 is a short narrative teaching about the necessity of hitbodedut for spiritual growth. It contains zero bechina (parallel-aspect) statements. All relationships in the text are causal/advisory (eitza): hitbodedut leads to becoming a true tzaddik, King David's practice of heart-breaking led to the Book of Psalms. Without any bechina edges, no packages can be formed. The teaching lacks the structural complexity (3+ bechina-connected concepts) needed for package formation.
